requirements.title: Zebra Repeat Print
requirements.definition: Visual and repeat-construction requirements for the zebra pareo artwork, including stripe direction, scale, colour, texture, contrast, edge treatment, and border treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Scale, palette, stripe treatment, texture, and border are attributes of one zebra artwork mechanism; the basket-weave and block-colour artworks can change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Diagonal Basket-Weave Repeat Print
requirements.definition: Visual and repeat-construction requirements for the diagonal basket-weave pareo artwork, including diamond scale, handcrafted texture, colour, grain, contrast, edge treatment, and border treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Diamond scale, palette, texture, and border are attributes of one basket-weave artwork; the zebra artwork has an independent selection and revision trajectory.

requirements.title: Mustard Block-Colour Pareo
requirements.definition: The mustard block-colour pareo artwork, including its interior and border colour arrangement and selected border scale.
requirements.boundary_note: This colourway is separate from the terracotta or burgundy colourway because its colour layout can be corrected and accepted independently, as indicated by the Tela Mare 3 error report.

requirements.title: Terracotta or Burgundy Block-Colour Pareo
requirements.definition: The terracotta or burgundy block-colour pareo artwork, including its interior and border colour arrangement and selected border scale.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently deliverable colourway rather than an attribute of the mustard pareo; shared border measurements remain attributes of each affected block-colour artwork.

requirements.title: Pareo Artwork Dimensions and Seam Allowance
requirements.definition: Required physical artwork dimensions and seam allowance for the production pareo files.
requirements.boundary_note: Dimensions and seam allowance form one production-sizing mechanism and can change independently of visual design, file format, colour calibration, and documentation.

requirements.title: Production Print File Format
requirements.definition: Technical output requirements for production-ready textile artwork files, including print-ready format, CMYK colour mode, adequate resolution, and clean repeat construction where applicable.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers the technical structure and output format of the files, not their dimensions, visual content, fabric-specific colour calibration, or the separate technical-sheet artifact.

requirements.title: Fabric Print Colour Calibration
requirements.definition: Colour preparation of the artwork for digital printing on the selected voile fabric using appropriate CMYK, Pantone, and supplier ICC information when available.
requirements.boundary_note: Fabric and printer calibration is independently actionable from the creative palette of any one design and from merely documenting colour references in the technical sheet.

requirements.title: Production Technical Sheet
requirements.definition: A production documentation artifact recording the final colour references, file specifications, measurements, and relevant supplier notes for the delivered artwork.
requirements.boundary_note: The technical sheet is independently editable and can contain an error even when the corresponding artwork files are correct, so it remains separate from the artwork and file-format Requirements.
